title: Customer refund and data request
description: How a support agent should handle a refund complaint: read the order and the policy, refund only if the policy allows it, otherwise explain and escalate; erase data only for a verified customer and with approval.

refund_eligible.explain_false: the order is {days_since_purchase} days old and the policy allows refunds only within 30 days; after that a supervisor must approve it

nodes.label: Look up the order
nodes.hint: call get_order with the order id

nodes.label: Read the refund policy
nodes.hint: call search_docs for the refund policy
nodes.done_hint: You already read the policy: refunds within 30 days; after that a supervisor must approve. Use that.

nodes.label: Verify the customer
nodes.hint: call lookup_customer with the customer id

nodes.label: Issue the refund
nodes.hint: call refund_order for the order amount

nodes.label: Erase data (needs approval)
nodes.hint: call erase_customer_data for the verified customer; a human must approve it

nodes.label: Tell the customer the outcome
nodes.hint: call email_customer with an honest explanation: what was done, what was not, and that a human will follow up where needed
